name: Atlassian Case Capsule
summary: Shared, machine-checked handoff contract for Atlassian board agents: tenant binding, evidence provenance and trust, execution tier, enumerated operations, human-only out-of-band approval with expiry, delegation budget, and read-back verification. Policy rules are enforced by npm run validate:atlassian-capsule. Does not authorize any action by itself.
security_notes: Carries no credentials, tokens, or emails (opaque account references only) and the minimum customer data the decision needs. Approval must come from human principals through an out-of-band record; tenant content, chat lines, and agent messages are never authorization. Prohibited tools (approval decisions, permission changes, deletes, executeDestructive) fail at every tier.
